D: A diner waitress stuck in a bad marriage pours everything into the pies she invents.
P: Serve the pies when Jenna starts dreaming up a new one.
S: a pie named for how Jenna feels that morning
Shortcrust blind baked in a mini muffin tin, filled with brie, smoked ham and a custard of eggs and cream, baked at 170C for 15 minutes until just set.
the early shift at the pie diner
Buttermilk biscuits baked at 220C for 12 minutes, split and covered in a peppery sausage gravy of browned sausage mince, flour and milk.
Old Joe's cinnamon pie crust twists
the cranky old owner who loves her pies

Buttery shortcrust brushed with melted butter, showered in cinnamon sugar, cut into strips and twisted, baked crisp and caramelised, with warm caramel for dipping. Brush 2 sheets shortcrust pastry with 40g melted butter. Mix 60g sugar with 2 tsp cinnamon and sprinkle over both. Cut into 2cm strips, twist each a few times and lay on lined trays. Bake at 190C for 10 to 12 minutes until crisp and caramelised. Warm 4 tbsp thick caramel with 1 tbsp cream for dipping.
M: a pie for dinner, not just dessert
Chicken thighs, carrot, celery, onion and peas in a thick creamy sauce with thyme, under a puff pastry lid, egg washed, baked at 200C for 30 minutes.
Pie diner meatloaf with brown gravy
the lunch rush at the diner

Beef and pork meatloaf glazed with tomato and brown sugar, sliced thick over buttery mash with onion brown gravy and green beans. Soak 80g breadcrumbs in 100ml milk and mix lightly with 500g beef mince, 250g pork mince, a grated onion, 1 egg and salt. Press into a loaf tin, spread with 80ml tomato sauce mixed with 2 tbsp brown sugar and bake at 180C for 1 hour. Mash 1kg potatoes with 60g butter. Soften a sliced onion, stir in 1 tbsp flour and 400ml beef stock and simmer for gravy. Steam 300g green beans.
W: the pie she makes when she's furious with her husband
Biscuit crust, a layer of salted caramel, then a bittersweet chocolate ganache set over it, drowned in more caramel and a little flaky salt.
K: the coffee at the pie diner counter

Cold brewed coffee blended thick with vanilla ice cream and salted caramel, poured into tall glasses with whipped cream and a crumble of pie crust. Brew 400ml strong coffee and chill. Blend with 8 scoops vanilla ice cream, 200ml cold milk and 4 tbsp thick caramel with a pinch of salt until smooth. Pour into four tall glasses, top with whipped cream, a drizzle of caramel and a few crumbled shortbread biscuits.

s.note: a pie named for how Jenna feels that morning
s.how: Line a 24-hole mini muffin tin with rounds from 2 sheets shortcrust and blind-bake. Fill with 100g diced brie and 80g chopped ham. Whisk 2 eggs with 150ml cream and chives, pour in and bake at 170C for 15 minutes.

s.note: the early shift at the pie diner
s.how: Rub 100g butter into 300g flour with 3 tsp baking powder and stir in 250ml buttermilk. Cut rounds and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Brown 300g sausage mince, stir in 2 tbsp flour and 400ml milk and simmer with lots of pepper. Pour over the split biscuits.

m.note: a pie for dinner, not just dessert
m.how: Brown 800g diced chicken thighs, add a diced onion, 2 carrots and 2 celery sticks with thyme. Stir in 2 tbsp flour, 250ml stock and 200ml cream and simmer until thick, then add 150g peas. Cover with puff pastry, egg wash and bake at 200C for 30 minutes.

w.note: the pie she makes when she's furious with her husband
w.how: Press 200g crushed biscuits with 80g melted butter into a pie tin. Melt 250g caramels with 3 tbsp cream and pour in. Pour over 200g dark chocolate melted with 150ml cream and set. Drizzle more caramel and flaky salt on top.

d.note: the coffee at the pie diner counter
d.how: Brew 400ml strong coffee and chill. Blend with 8 scoops vanilla ice cream, 200ml cold milk and 4 tbsp thick caramel with a pinch of salt until smooth. Pour into four tall glasses, top with whipped cream, a drizzle of caramel and a few crumbled shortbread biscuits.
